notes.title: Evenicle 2 - Clinical Trial Edition is out now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38294721/fa55fbd0c7d7e5ca87f727eca46fb74529abc757.jpg[/img]

Evenicle 2 - Clinical Trial Edition — a free and extended demo of Evenicle 2 — is now out on Steam!

Let us know what you think about it with a tweet!
You can find our official Twitter account here: https://twitter.com/Alicesoft_en

We're looking forward to hearing your opinions and feedback so we can improve and ensure a better and smoother release for all our future titles!
